facts.fact: L'Opinion reports that draft law 052.26, not yet adopted, would create a shared medical record for every patient and oblige public and private providers to feed it at each act or consultation, private ones connecting their systems within 24 months of the implementing decree, on pain of fines of 50,000 to 300,000 dirhams; the record does not yet exist and the article gives no date for the bill, so the publication date is used.
